PLAN "Cycle-Phased Strength — Stage III Endometriosis"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Build full-body strength across 12 weeks, modulated around menstrual cycle phases and acyclic flare windows"

PHASES

  PHASE "Phase 1 — Follicular Foundation" (4 weeks):

    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Lower Body Strength — Follicular":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          leg_curl 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          standing_calf_raise 3x15 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 3m
          hamstring_stretch 3m

      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Upper Body Strength — Follicular":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          bent_over_row 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          bicep_curl 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
